notes.title: Update: Added 4 difficulty levels!
notes.content:
Hello SWATs!

This update is huge. Most noticeable feature is the addition of 4 difficulty levels that include aim assistant  for less expert cops and a highly demanded feature, a warning indicator when enemies are going to hit you imminently. 

[h3]Added 4 difficulty levels[/h3]

[b]- Rookie[/b]
With aim assistant and warnings. A very enjoyable difficulty level, had you a hard day? Then pick this level and blow some brain caps. But be careful! Rambo will not survive, you still have to cover. If you see a warning, take cover!

[b]- Cadet[/b]
Only warnings. Your aim performance is solid, and you are ready for a challenge.

[b]- Veteran[/b]
You are on your own. Pick this difficulty level to live a true shooting simulation. Finishing the game is great, but authentic SWATs must finish this level.

[b]- Hell[/b]
Veteran level is boring for you. This is the definitive challenge, you have limited ammunition. Only a received shot is more painful than each bullet lost. The feeling is so different and so good that you have to try it. This is madness! No, this is Sparta!

[h3]Other new features[/h3]

- Improved enemies AI.
- Less cheap deaths.
- Redefined stages. If you memorized the game, now you will find it a bit different.
- Improved spawns and randomization. Now spawns are more random and stages may vary.
- Improved enemies physics.
- Added reload and reloading indicators.

But the more time consuming feature, not noticeable, is that we have redesigned all stages to make the game cross-platform for the co-op mode. This was needed and delayed the co-op mode again, but now it will go very fast.

I hope you like it. This new version is amazing.

- Redefined stages. If you memorized the game, now you will find it a bit different.
- Improved spawns and randomization. Now spawns are more random and stages may vary.

notes.title: Update: Dual Wield & Riot Shield
notes.content:
Because 1 pistol is not enough... take this! Start with 2 pistols or even better, start with 2 R-90. THIS IS FIREPOWER!!!


New features:

[h3]Dual wielding[/h3]
Double your weapons and double your firepower. Start from the beginning with 2 weapons and crush your enemies with a bullet rain.

[h3]Riot shield[/h3]
If you can't or don't want to do squats, or because it is fun, this is for you. Use it to cover behind it and kill all your enemies standing or seated. Your choice.

This update has taken a while because we have a lot of work to do to support the co-op online (also holidays delayed it...). This feature has been delayed to fall, but the development is progressing very fast and we are working on the 3rd phase.

Also we are working on new content, more missions... stay tuned!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch released: Modify the weapon angle in settings. Fixed left handed issues.
notes.content:
New Feature:

Modify the weapon angle. You will find in settings 2 buttons to change the weapon angle. It changes the angle by 1 degree each shot, so the change is not very noticeable at first sight, but definitively the angle changes and it is very precise.

Also we have fixed the issues for left handed. Let us know if you find something more, we have not left handed people in our team and may be we have missed something more.

Some other minor issues have been fixed and we are addressing all things you are reporting. Thank you!
